}

  requires k >= 0 and k <= len(xs)
  ensures len(result) == len(xs) - k
  ensures forall x in result: contains(xs, x)
  effects pure
  example drop([1, 2, 3], 1) == [2, 3]
  example drop([1, 2, 3], 3) == []
  example drop([1, 2, 3], 0) == [1, 2, 3]
{
  if k == 0 then xs else match xs {
    [] => []
    [_, ..t] => drop(t, k - 1)
  }
}
